entries.rationale: ai-dossier#747: gh pr merge (GraphQL) hit a stuck-lock-after-502 (PR #745), a skip-ci-in-squash-body trap (PR #602), and a base-branch-modified race (#655). Moved per-issue merge to the REST endpoint with sha=, a fixed marker-free commit_message, and a bounded poll-then-retry loop on 5xx that polls mergedAt before retrying.

entries.anchor: ### Step 3a.5: Verdict-Freshness Gate — never authorize a merge for a diff no review saw
entries.rationale: ai-dossier#851: git < 2.39 rejects patch-id --verbatim (exit 129) and yields EMPTY ids that could compare equal. The gate now tries tree equality when both heads share a merge-base (exact, any git), --verbatim patch-id only when the bases differ and support is probed, never compares an empty id, never falls back to whitespace-blind --stable, and records verdict_check=tree|patch-id|inconclusive|sha-fallback.

entries.anchor: ### Step 3c: Ship Mode — attached or detached
entries.rationale: ai-dossier#860: detached ship parked PRs on a label nothing watched (no watcher workflow, autoMergeRequest=null). Step 3c now finds the merge mechanism before parking (watcher, or native auto-merge requested after review), runs attached when there is none, asserts after parking and blocks reason=no-merge-mechanism; every mode merges only after the full review round (#795 / PR #837).
